claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Didanosine is a nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor prodrug that requires intracellular phosphorylation and incorporation into DNA; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive because its chain-terminating activity is selective for reverse transcriptase and its mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma inhibition is weak and requires prolonged exposure.
